newsitem.title: KENYA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA PUT IN TO BAT IN ONE-DAYER WITH PAKISTAN.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA PUT IN TO BAT IN ONE-DAYER WITH PAKISTAN.

text.p: Pakistan won the toss and put South Africa into bat in their one-day match in the Kenyan Centenary four-nation cricket tournament on Sunday.
South Africa: Andrew Hudson, Gary Kirsten, Hansie Cronje (captain), Daryll Cullinan, Jonty Rhodes, Brian McMillan, Pat Symcox, Dave Richardson, Craig Matthews, Fanie de Villiers, Allan Donald.
Pakistan: Saeed Anwar, Saleem Elahi, Ijaz Ahmed, Salim Malik, Azhar Mahmood, Saeed Azad, Wasim Akram (captain), Moin Khan, Shahid Nazir, Saqlain Mustaq, Waqar Younis.
